/** @brief Layer 2 scene 0 — horizontal pan. */
static void end_402_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_4_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_4_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->speed_x = 0x8000;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal -= bgw_ptr->speed_x;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos < 161) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Layer 2 scene 1 — timed wait then diagonal pan with effect. */
static void end_402_1000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_4_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_4_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        effect_E6_init(0x5E);
        bgw_ptr->free = 0x12C;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->speed_x = 0xA000;
            bgw_ptr->speed_y = 0x4000;
            bgw_ptr->free = 0xF0;
            break;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        } else {
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal -= bgw_ptr->speed_x;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal += bgw_ptr->speed_y;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 3:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Necro's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_05000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_5_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x32);
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 == 13) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_5_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[2].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_500_move();
        end_501_move();
        /* fallthough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_500_move() {
    void (*end_500_jp[13])() = { end_500_comm, end_500_0001, end_500_0001, end_500_comm, end_500_comm,
                                 end_500_comm, end_500_0006, end_500_0007, end_500_0008, end_X_com01,
                                 end_X_com01,  end_500_0011, end_X_com01 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 13)
        return;
    end_500_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Common scene handler — background setup with message and effects. */
static void end_500_comm() {
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];

    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_5_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_5_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];

        switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_2) {
        case 0:
            Bg_On_W(1);
            Rewrite_End_Message(0);
            break;

        case 3:
            bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
            bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
            Rewrite_End_Message(3);
            break;

        case 4:
            effect_E6_init(0xB);
            Rewrite_End_Message(4);
            break;

        case 5:
            effect_E6_init(0xC);
            effect_E6_init(0xD);
            Rewrite_End_Message(5);
            break;
        }

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 1 — background setup with vertical scroll. */
static void end_500_0001() {
    bgw_ptr = g_state.bg_w.bgw;

    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_5_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_5_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->frame_deff = 0;
        bgw_ptr->free = necro_quake_timer[bgw_ptr->frame_deff];

        switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_2) {
        case 1:
            effect_E6_init(9);
            Rewrite_End_Message(1);
            break;

        case 2:
            effect_E6_init(0xA);
            Rewrite_End_Message(2);
            break;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->frame_deff++;
            bgw_ptr->frame_deff &= 0x1F;
            bgw_ptr->free = necro_quake_timer[bgw_ptr->frame_deff];
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_5_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos += necro_quake_tbl[bgw_ptr->frame_deff][0];
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_5_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos += necro_quake_tbl[bgw_ptr->frame_deff][1];
            bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
            bgw_ptr->abs_x += necro_quake_tbl[bgw_ptr->frame_deff][0];
            bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
            bgw_ptr->abs_y += necro_quake_tbl[bgw_ptr->frame_deff][1];
        }

        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 6 — background with quake effect sequence. */
static void end_500_0006() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        if (Request_Fade(1) != 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 1;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (end_fade_complete()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 0;
            g_state.end_w.timer = 30;
            overwrite_panel(0xFF000000, 0x17);
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        overwrite_panel(0xFF000000, 0x17);
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Apply vertical quake offset to background Y position. */
static void end_500_quake_y_sub() {
    bgw_ptr->frame_deff--;

    if (bgw_ptr->frame_deff <= 0) {
        bgw_ptr->frame_deff = 4;
        g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index++;
        g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index &= 7;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos += end_500_quake_tbl[g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index];
        bgw_ptr->abs_y += end_500_quake_tbl[g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index];
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 7 — quake effect with lightning flash. */
static void end_500_0007() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        overwrite_panel(0xFF000000, 0x17);
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_Off_W(1);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = 512;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 768;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        effect_E6_init(0xF);
        effect_E6_init(0x49);
        break;

    case 1:
        break;

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->free = 0x28;
        break;

    case 3:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free < 1) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        break;

    case 4:
        end_5_bg0_move_sub();

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos < 193) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            effect_E6_init(0x11);
            g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index = 0;
            bgw_ptr->frame_deff = 4;
        }

        break;

    case 5:
        end_5_bg0_move_sub();
        end_500_quake_y_sub();

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos < -127) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            g_state.end_w.timer = 0;
        }

        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 8 — quake effect with multiple effects and fade. */

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos < -1008) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            effect_E6_init(0x15);
        }

        break;

    case 4:

/** @brief Animate layer 0 background scroll. */
static void end_5_bg0_move_sub() {
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 == 7) {
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal += 0xFFF60000;
    } else {
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal += 0xFFFA0000;
    }

    bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
}

/** @brief Animate layer 1 background scroll. */
static void end_5_bg1_move_sub() {
    bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal += 0xFFF00000;
    bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;

    if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos < 193) {
        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos == 768) {
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = bgw_ptr->abs_x = 448;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 512;
            return;
        }

        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = bgw_ptr->abs_x = 704;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 768;
    }
}

/** @brief Animate layer 1 background scroll (variant 2). */
static void end_5_bg1_move_sub2() {
    bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal += 0x180000;
    bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;

    if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos == 768) {
        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos >= 704) {
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = bgw_ptr->abs_x = 192;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 512;
        }
    } else if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos >= 448) {
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = bgw_ptr->abs_x = 192;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 768;
    }
}

static void end_600_4000();
static void end_600_5000();

static void end_601_0000();
static void end_601_1000();
static void end_601_2000();
static void end_601_3000();

const s16 timer_6_tbl[6] = { 420, 360, 120, 1080, 720, 540 };

const s16 end_6_pos[6][2] = { { 256, 768 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 256 }, { 256, 0 }, { 768, 768 }, { 768, 512 } };

const s16 end_600_1000_tbl[8][2] = { { -4, 2 }, { 6, -6 }, { -2, 4 }, { -4, 3 },
                                     { 11, 0 }, { -4, 2 }, { 8, 0 },  { 2, -2 } };

const s16 end_600_2000_tbl[12][2] = { { 3, -2 }, { 1, 3 }, { 2, -1 }, { 3, -2 }, { 2, 3 }, { 2, -2 },
                                      { 3, -2 }, { 2, 3 }, { 2, -2 }, { 3, -2 }, { 1, 3 }, { 2, -1 } };

/** @brief Hugo's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_06000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_6_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x32);
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 6) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_6_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_600_move();
        end_601_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_600_move() {
    void (*end_600_jp[6])() = { end_600_0000, end_600_1000, end_600_2000, end_600_3000, end_600_4000, end_600_5000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 6)
        return;
    end_600_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene 0 — initial background setup with message. */
static void end_600_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << bgw_ptr->fam_no);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        Rewrite_End_Message(1);
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 1 — timed horizontal pan with message. */
static void end_600_1000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << (bgw_ptr->fam_no));
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        bgw_ptr->free = 0;
        bgw_ptr->old_pos_x = 0;
        Rewrite_End_Message(2);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x8000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 625) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0x2700000;
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->old_pos_x++;

        if (bgw_ptr->old_pos_x > 2) {
            bgw_ptr->old_pos_x = 0;
            bgw_ptr->free++;
            bgw_ptr->free &= 7;
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_600_1000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0] + 0x100;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos += end_600_1000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][1];
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 2 — animated camera shake pattern. */
static void end_600_2000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1] + 16;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1] + 16;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 0x210;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 16;
        bgw_ptr->free = 0;
        bgw_ptr->old_pos_x = 16;
        effect_E6_init(0x2B);
        Rewrite_End_Message(0);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->old_pos_x--;

        if (bgw_ptr->old_pos_x < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->old_pos_x = end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0];
            bgw_ptr->free++;
            bgw_ptr->free &= 7;
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0] + end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0];
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1] + end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][1];

            bgw_ptr->abs_x = end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0] + 0x200;
            bgw_ptr->abs_y = end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][1];
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->old_pos_x--;

        if (bgw_ptr->old_pos_x < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->old_pos_x = end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0];
            bgw_ptr->free++;
            bgw_ptr->free &= 7;
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0] + end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0];
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1] + end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][1];

            bgw_ptr->abs_x = end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0] + 0x200;
            bgw_ptr->abs_y = end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][1];
        }

        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 3 — fade-in with message rewrite. */
static void end_600_3000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        Rewrite_End_Message(3);
        effect_E6_init(0x2D);
        effect_E6_init(0x2E);
        bgw_ptr->free = 0x1E;
        break;

    case 1:
    case 2:
    case 3:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->free = 0x1E;
            effect_E6_init(0x31);
        }

        break;

    case 4:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 4 — static background with horizontal pan. */
static void end_600_4000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        Rewrite_End_Message(4);
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 5 — final scene with fade timer and vertical scroll. */
static void end_600_5000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        Rewrite_End_Message(5);
        bgw_ptr->free = 0x1E;
        end_fade_flag = 1;
        end_fade_timer = timer_6_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2] - 120;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->free = 3;
            bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->free = 3;
            bgw_ptr->l_limit++;

            if (bgw_ptr->l_limit >= 4) {
                bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
            }
        }

        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 1. */
static void end_601_move() {
    void (*end_601_jp[6])() = { end_601_0000, end_601_1000, end_601_2000, end_601_3000, end_X_com01, end_X_com01 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[1];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 6)
        return;
    end_601_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 0 — horizontal pan setup. */
static void end_601_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << bgw_ptr->fam_no);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 1 — timed horizontal pan. */
static void end_601_1000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << bgw_ptr->fam_no);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x2000;

        if (g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 >= 2) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 2 — animated shake with lightning effects. */
static void end_601_2000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_Off_W(1 << (bgw_ptr->fam_no));
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1] - 16;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1] - 16;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 0x1F0;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = -16;
        bgw_ptr->free = 0;
        bgw_ptr->old_pos_x = 16;

        if (g_state.Country == COUNTRY_JAPAN || g_state.Country == COUNTRY_KOREA) {
            effect_E6_init(0x2C);
            break;
        }

        effect_E6_init(0x98);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->old_pos_x--;

        if (bgw_ptr->old_pos_x < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->old_pos_x = end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0];
            bgw_ptr->free++;
            bgw_ptr->free &= 7;
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0] - end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0];
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1] - end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][1];

            bgw_ptr->abs_x = 0x200 - end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][0];
            bgw_ptr->abs_y = -end_600_2000_tbl[bgw_ptr->free][1];
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 3 — static background with position set. */
static void end_601_3000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << bgw_ptr->fam_no);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_6_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/**

#include "common.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_b0_timer_ending_data.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_e6_ending_scene_gill_general.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_f9_text_message.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/end_data.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/end_main.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/sound/sound_effects.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/bg.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/stage_data.h"

static void end_700_move();
static void end_701_move();

static void end_700_0000();
static void end_700_2000();

const s16 timer_7_tbl[4] = { 480, 840, 840, 960 };

const s16 end_7_pos[4][2] = { { 256, 768 }, { 768, 768 }, { 768, 512 }, { 256, 256 } };

/** @brief Ibuki's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_07000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_7_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x31);
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 4) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_7_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_700_move();
        end_701_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_700_move() {
    void (*end_700_jp[4])() = { end_700_0000, end_700_0000, end_700_2000, end_700_0000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 4)
        return;
    end_700_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 1. */
static void end_701_move() {
    void (*end_701_jp[4])() = { end_X_com01, end_700_0000, end_X_com01, end_700_0000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[1];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 4)
        return;
    end_701_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene handler — background setup with per-scene effects and messages. */
static void end_700_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << bgw_ptr->fam_no);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_7_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_7_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];

        if (bgw_ptr->fam_no == 0) {
            switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_2) {
            case 0:
                effect_E6_init(0x5B);
                Rewrite_End_Message(1);
                break;

            case 1:
                effect_B0_init();
                Rewrite_End_Message(2);
                break;

            case 3:
                bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
                effect_E6_init(0x5A);
                Rewrite_End_Message(4);
                end_fade_flag = 1;
                end_fade_timer = timer_7_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2] - 120;
                break;
            }
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 2 — horizontal scroll with effect. */
static void end_700_2000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_7_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_7_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        effect_E6_init(0x59);
        Rewrite_End_Message(3);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal -= 0x8000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos < 289) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal = 0x1200000;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        break;
    }
}

/**

 * Elena's Ending
 */

#include "common.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_e6_ending_scene_gill_general.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_f9_text_message.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/end_data.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/end_main.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/sound/sound_effects.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/bg.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/stage_data.h"

static void end_800_move();

static void end_8000_0000();
static void end_8000_0001();
static void end_8000_0002();

const s16 timer_8_tbl[4] = { 840, 480, 900, 360 };

const s16 end_8_pos[4][2] = { { 256, 768 }, { 256, 512 }, { 256, 0 }, { 768, 512 } };

/** @brief Elena's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_08000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x31);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_8_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if ((g_state.end_w.r_no_2) == 4) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_8_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_800_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_800_move() {
    void (*end_800_jp[4])() = { end_8000_0000, end_8000_0001, end_8000_0002, end_8000_0002 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 4)
        return;
    end_800_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene 0 — horizontal pan with effect initialization. */
static void end_8000_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1);
        effect_E6_init(0x46);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_8_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_8_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        Rewrite_End_Message(1);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal += 0x8000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos > 448) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal = 0x1C00000;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 2:
        break;

        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

        break;

/**
 * @file ending_09_oro.c
 * Oro's Ending
 */

#include "common.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_e6_ending_scene_gill_general.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_f9_text_message.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/end_data.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/end_main.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/sound/sound_effects.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/bg.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/stage_data.h"

static void end_900_move();

static void end_900_0000();
static void end_900_5000();

const s16 timer_9_tbl[6] = { 300, 480, 120, 540, 780, 600 };

const s16 end_9_pos[6][2] = { { 256, 512 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 336 }, { 256, 0 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 512 } };

/** @brief Oro's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_09000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        common_end_init01();
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_9_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        BGM_Request(0x32);
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 == 6) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_9_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_900_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_900_move() {
    void (*end_900_jp[6])() = { end_900_0000, end_900_0000, end_900_0000, end_900_0000, end_900_0000, end_900_5000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 6)
        return;
    end_900_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene handler — per-scene background setup with effects and messages. */
static void end_900_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_9_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_9_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];

        switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_2) {
        case 0:
            Bg_On_W(1);
            bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
            bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
            effect_E6_init(0x24);
            Rewrite_End_Message(1);
            break;

        case 1:
            Rewrite_End_Message(2);
            effect_E6_init(0x25);
            break;

        case 2:
            Rewrite_End_Message(3);
            break;

        case 3:
            effect_E6_init(0x26);
            effect_E6_init(0x27);
            effect_E6_init(0x28);
            effect_E6_init(0x29);
            Rewrite_End_Message(4);
            break;

        case 4:
            Rewrite_End_Message(5);
            effect_E6_init(0x25);
            break;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 5 — final scene with vertical scroll and fade timer. */
static void end_900_5000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        effect_E6_init(0x2A);
        bgw_ptr->free = 0x1E;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_9_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_9_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        Rewrite_End_Message(6);
        end_fade_flag = 1;
        end_fade_timer = timer_9_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2] - 120;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x8000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 337) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0x1500000;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 3:
        break;
    }
}

        common_end_init00(pl_num);

            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[2].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[5].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_1000_move();
        end_1001_move();
        end_1002_move();
        end_1003_move();

        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_10_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->free = 4;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
        Rewrite_End_Message(1);

        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x31);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_b_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 7) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_b_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        if (g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index > 0) {
            g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index--;
        }

        end_b00_move();
        end_b01_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_b00_move() {
    void (*end_b00_jp[7])() = { end_b00_0000, end_b00_1000, end_b00_0000, end_b00_3000,
                                end_b00_0000, end_b00_0000, end_b00_0000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 7)
        return;
    end_b00_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene handler — per-scene background setup with effects. */
static void end_b00_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;

        switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_2) {
        case 0:
            Bg_Off_W(1);
            effect_E6_init(0x60);
            Rewrite_End_Message(1);
            break;

        case 2:
            Bg_Off_W(1);
            effect_E6_init(0x62);
            Rewrite_End_Message(0);
            break;

        case 4:
            effect_E6_init(0x65);
            effect_E6_init(0x66);
            effect_E6_init(0x67);
            effect_E6_init(0x68);
            Rewrite_End_Message(3);
            break;

        case 5:
            effect_E6_init(0x69);
            effect_E6_init(0x6A);
            effect_E6_init(0x6D);
            effect_E6_init(0x6E);
            effect_E6_init(0x6B);
            Rewrite_End_Message(4);
            break;

        case 6:
            effect_E6_init(0x6C);
            Rewrite_End_Message(5);
            end_fade_flag = 1;
            end_fade_timer = timer_b_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2] - 120;
            break;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 1 — background enable with effect flag wait. */
static void end_b00_1000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        end_etc_flag = 0;
        effect_E6_init(0x61);
        Rewrite_End_Message(0);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (end_etc_flag) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            g_state.end_w.timer = 10;
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 3 — quake effect with effect init. */
static void end_b00_3000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        Bg_On_W(1);
        g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index = 24;
        bgw_ptr->free = 2;
        effect_E6_init(0x63);
        Rewrite_End_Message(2);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->free = 2;

            if (g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index <= 0) {
                bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
                bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
                bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
                effect_E6_init(0x64);
                break;
            }
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = (s16)quake_y_tbl[g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index] + end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
            bgw_ptr->abs_y = quake_y_tbl[g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index];
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 1. */
static void end_b01_move() {
    void (*end_b01_jp[7])() = { end_b01_0000, end_X_com01, end_b01_0000, end_b01_3000,
                                end_X_com01,  end_X_com01, end_X_com01 };

    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 7)
        return;
    end_b01_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 0 — vertical scroll with direction control. */
static void end_b01_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];

        if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 == 1) {
            bgw_ptr->speed_y = 0x100000;
            break;
        }

        bgw_ptr->speed_y = -0x40000;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(2U);
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal += bgw_ptr->speed_y;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y += bgw_ptr->speed_y;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 33) {
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 288;
        }

        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 3 — quake-synced layer position. */
static void end_b01_3000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        Bg_On_W(2U);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index) {
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = (s16)quake_y_tbl[g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index] + end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
            bgw_ptr->abs_y = quake_y_tbl[g_state.bg_w.quake_y_index];
            break;
        }

        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_b_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

static void end_C01_move();

static void end_C00_1000();
static void end_C00_2000();
static void end_C00_3000();
static void end_C00_4000();
static void end_C00_5000();
static void end_C00_6000();

const s16 timer_c_tbl[7] = { 600, 600, 360, 420, 360, 540, 420 };

const s16 end_c_pos[7][2] = { { 256, 32 },  { 768, 768 }, { 768, 768 }, { 768, 512 },
                              { 768, 768 }, { 768, 256 }, { 768, 256 } };

/** @brief Sean's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_12000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        common_end_init01();
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_c_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        BGM_Request(0x31);
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;
        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 == 7) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_c_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[2].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_C00_move();
        end_C01_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_C00_move() {
    void (*end_C00_jp[7])() = { end_C00_0000, end_C00_1000, end_C00_2000, end_C00_3000,
                                end_C00_4000, end_C00_5000, end_C00_6000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 7)
        return;
    end_C00_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene 0 — vertical scroll with particle effect trigger. */
static void end_C00_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        Rewrite_End_Message(1);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos > 304) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            effect_F2_init();
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal += 0x10000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos > 384) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0x1800000;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 3:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 1 — effect with message and animation flags. */
static void end_C00_1000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        effect_E6_init(0x39);
        Rewrite_End_Message(2);
        bgw_ptr->free = 0;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit = 3;
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 2 — fade to white panel. */
static void end_C00_2000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        if (Request_Fade(3)) {
            end_no_cut = 1;
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (end_fade_complete()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 0;
            g_state.end_w.timer = 0x14;
            overwrite_panel(0xFFFFFFFF, 0x17);
        }

        break;

    default:
        overwrite_panel(0xFFFFFFFF, 0x17);
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 3 — white panel fade out with message. */
static void end_C00_3000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        overwrite_panel(0xFFFFFFFF, 0x17);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        Rewrite_End_Message(3);
        /* fallthrough */

    case 1:
        overwrite_panel(0xFFFFFFFF, 0x17);

        if (Request_Fade(2)) {
            end_no_cut = 1;
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (end_fade_complete()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 0;
        }

        break;
    }
}

        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        effect_E6_init(0x3B);

        bgw_ptr->free = 0;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit = 3;
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }

        break;

        break;

/** @brief Scene 6 — timed wait then effect with fade timer. */
static void end_C00_6000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_c_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];

        end_fade_timer = timer_c_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2] - 120;

        break;

        break;

            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;

        break;

/**
 * @file ending_13_urien.c
 * Urien's Ending
 */

#include "common.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_e6_ending_scene_gill_general.h"

static void end_d00_2000();
static void end_d00_3000();
static void end_d00_4000();
static void end_d00_6000();
static void end_d00_7000();

static void end_d01_4000();

const s16 end_d_pos[8][2] = { { 256, 0 },   { 256, 768 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 512 },
                              { 192, 256 }, { 256, 512 }, { 256, 0 },   { 256, 0 } };

/** @brief Urien's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_13000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_d_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x32);
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 == 1) {
                effect_E6_init(0x32);
                effect_E6_init(0x33);
            }

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 8) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_d_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_d00_move();
        end_d01_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */

    void (*end_d00_jp[8])() = { end_d00_1000, end_d00_1000, end_d00_2000, end_d00_3000,
                                end_d00_4000, end_d00_1000, end_d00_6000, end_d00_7000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 8)
        return;
    end_d00_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene handler — per-scene background setup with optional effects. */
static void end_d00_1000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << bgw_ptr->fam_no);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;

        switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_2) {
        case 0:
            break;

        case 1:
            effect_E6_init(0x34);
            break;

        case 5:
            Bg_Off_W(1);
            Rewrite_End_Message(3);
            break;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 2 — fade to white panel. */
static void end_d00_2000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        if (Request_Fade(3)) {
            end_no_cut = 1;
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (end_fade_complete()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 0;
            g_state.end_w.timer = 20;
            overwrite_panel(0xFFFFFFFF, 0x17);
            break;
        }

        break;

    default:
        overwrite_panel(0xFFFFFFFF, 0x17);
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 3 — white panel fade with effect init. */
static void end_d00_3000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        overwrite_panel(0xFFFFFFFF, 0x17);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        effect_E6_init(0x35);
        /* fallthrough */

    case 1:
        overwrite_panel(0xFFFFFFFF, 0x17);

        if (Request_Fade(2)) {
            end_no_cut = 1;
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            Rewrite_End_Message(1);
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (end_fade_complete()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 0;
        }

        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 4 — horizontal pan with dual effects and message. */
static void end_d00_4000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << bgw_ptr->fam_no);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        Rewrite_End_Message(2);
        effect_E6_init(0x36);
        effect_E6_init(0x37);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal += 0x8000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos > 304) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal = 0x1300000;
            bgw_ptr->free = 10;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 6 — alternating vertical shake with effect. */
static void end_d00_6000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1 << bgw_ptr->fam_no);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        effect_E6_init(0x4A);
        bgw_ptr->free = 0x3C;
        Rewrite_End_Message(0);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_etc_flag = 0;
            effect_E6_init(0x4B);
            bgw_ptr->free = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (!end_etc_flag) {
            bgw_ptr->free++;
            bgw_ptr->free &= 1;

            if (bgw_ptr->free) {
                bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos += 8;
                bgw_ptr->abs_y += 8;
                break;
            }

            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos -= 8;
            bgw_ptr->abs_y -= 8;
            break;
        }

        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.timer = 30;
        break;

    case 3:
        bgw_ptr->free++;
        bgw_ptr->free &= 1;

        if (bgw_ptr->free) {
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos += 8;
            bgw_ptr->abs_y += 8;
            break;
        }

        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos -= 8;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y -= 8;
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 7 — final scene with fade timer and message. */
static void end_d00_7000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_d_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;
        Rewrite_End_Message(4);
        end_fade_flag = 1;
        end_fade_timer = timer_d_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2] - 120;
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 1. */
static void end_d01_move() {
    void (*end_d01_jp[8])() = { end_X_com01,  end_X_com01, end_X_com01, end_X_com01,
                                end_d01_4000, end_X_com01, end_X_com01, end_X_com01 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[1];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 8)
        return;
    end_d01_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 4 — set position for background layer. */
static void end_d01_4000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        break;
    }
}

/**

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/ending_14_akuma.h"

static void end_e00_move();
static void end_e01_move();
static void end_e02_move();

static void end_e00_0000();
static void end_e00_1000();
static void end_e00_2000();
static void end_e00_3000();

struct {
    XY xy[2];
} gxy;

const s16 timer_e_tbl[9] = { 1320, 240, 900, 1200, 360, 360, 300, 420, 600 };

const s16 end_e_pos[10][2] = { { 256, 768 }, { 768, 0 }, { 768, 768 }, { 256, 0 },   { 768, 768 },
                               { 768, 768 }, { 256, 0 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 256 }, { 768, 256 } };

/** @brief Akuma/Gouki's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_14000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.palette_swap = 0;
        g_state.bg_rewrite[0] = 0;
        g_state.bg_rewrite[1] = 0;
        g_state.g_number[0] = 0;
        g_state.g_number[1] = 0;
        gxy.xy[1].disp.pos = 0;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_e_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x32);
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 == 8) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_e_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[2].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_e00_move();
        end_e01_move();
        end_e02_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_e00_move() {
    void (*end_e00_jp[8])() = { end_e00_0000, end_e00_1000, end_e00_2000, end_e00_3000,
                                end_e00_4000, end_e00_5000, end_e00_6000, end_e00_7000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 8)
        return;
    end_e00_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene 0 — color cycling animation with background setup. */
static void end_e00_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_e_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos += 64;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_e_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = end_e_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->free = 0x3C;
        Rewrite_End_Message(1);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x18000;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 273) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            effect_E6_init(0x19);
            gxy.xy[1].disp.pos = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
            g_state.palette_swap = 1;
            *scr_bcm = ending_map_tbl[20][0];
        }

        break;

    case 3:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x18000;
        gxy.xy[1].cal = gxy.xy[1].cal - 0x18000;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 0;
        }

        if (gxy.xy[1].disp.pos < -223) {
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 752;
        }

        break;

    case 4:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->free = 7;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
        g_state.bg_rewrite[0] = 1;
        /* fallthrough */

    case 5:
        if (end_e00_0000_col_sub()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 6:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x4000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 713) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0x2C80000;
            g_state.end_w.timer = 20;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 7:
        break;
    }
}

const u8 end_e00_0000_col_tbl[12] = { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 6 };

/** @brief Color sub-routine — cycle palette for scene 0. */
static s16 end_e00_0000_col_sub() {
    bgw_ptr->free--;

    if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
        bgw_ptr->free = 7;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit++;

        if (bgw_ptr->l_limit >= 12) {
            return 1;
        }

        *g_state.g_number = end_e00_0000_col_tbl[bgw_ptr->l_limit];
    }

    return 0;
}

/** @brief Color sub-routine 2 — reverse palette cycle. */
static s16 end_e00_0000_col_sub2() {
    bgw_ptr->free--;

    if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
        bgw_ptr->free = 7;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit++;

        if (bgw_ptr->l_limit >= 12) {
            return 1;
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

const u8 end_e00_1000_col_tbl[8] = { 0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 };

/** @brief Color sub-routine — fade-in palette for scene 1. */
static void end_e00_1000_col_sub() {
    if (bgw_ptr->l_limit >= 8) {
        return;
    }

    bgw_ptr->free--;

    if (bgw_ptr->free > 0) {
        return;
    }

    bgw_ptr->l_limit++;

    if (bgw_ptr->l_limit < 7) {
        bgw_ptr->free = 8;
        g_state.g_number[1] = end_e00_1000_col_tbl[bgw_ptr->l_limit];
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 1 — fade-in with color cycling effect. */
static void end_e00_1000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = 768;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = 128;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 128;
        bgw_ptr->free = 8;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
        g_state.bg_rewrite[1] = 1;
        g_state.g_number[1] = 0;
        Rewrite_End_Message(2);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x8000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 36) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0x240000;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_e00_1000_col_sub();
        break;
    }
}

const u8 end_e00_2000_col_tbl[8] = { 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, 0 };

/** @brief Scene 2 — reverse color cycle with fade-out. */
static void end_e00_2000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal += 0x10000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos > 80) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0x500000;
            bgw_ptr->free = 0x4E;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->free = 8;
            bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 3:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->l_limit++;

            if (bgw_ptr->l_limit >= 8) {
                bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.timer = 120;
                break;
            }

            bgw_ptr->free = 8;
            g_state.g_number[1] = end_e00_2000_col_tbl[bgw_ptr->l_limit];
        }

        break;

    case 4:
        g_state.bg_rewrite[1] = 0;
        g_state.g_number[1] = 0;
        break;
    }
}

        if (end_fade_complete()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 0;
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 3:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x3000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 697) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0x2B80000;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 4:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 1. */
static void end_e01_move() {
    void (*end_101_jp[8])() = { end_e01_0000, end_X_com01, end_X_com01, end_X_com01,
                                end_X_com01,  end_X_com01, end_X_com01, end_e01_7000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[1];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 8)
        return;
    end_101_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 0 — per-scene background setup with effects. */
static void end_e01_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(2);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_e_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_e_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        bgw_ptr->free = 0x3C;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x18000;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < 273) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            Bg_Off_W(2);
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 3:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x18000;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 4:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->free = 7;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
        /* fallthrough */

    case 5:
        if (end_e00_0000_col_sub2()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        }

        /* fallthrough */

    case 6:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal -= 0x4000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos < -311) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0xFEC80000;
            g_state.end_w.timer = 20;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 7:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Layer 1 scene 7 — vertical scroll with effects. */

        }

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

/**
 * @file ending_16_chun_li.c
 * Chun-Li's Ending
 */

#include "common.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_e6_ending_scene_gill_general.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_f9_text_message.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/end_data.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ending/end_main.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/sound/sound_effects.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/bg.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/stage/stage_data.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/system/system_subroutines.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/ui/hud_subroutines.h"

static void end_1600_move();

static void end_1600_0000();
static void end_1600_1000();
static void end_1600_2000();
static void end_1600_3000();
static void end_1600_3100();
static void end_1600_5000();

static void end_16_col_change();

const s16 timer_16_tbl[6] = { 660, 360, 360, 660, 660, 240 };

const s16 end_16_pos[7][2] = { { 256, 768 }, { 256, 768 }, { 768, 256 }, { 256, 256 },
                               { 256, 0 },   { 256, 0 },   { 768, 0 } };

/** @brief Chun-Li's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_16000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        g_state.char_rewrite = 0;
        g_state.c_number = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x31);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_16_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 6) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_16_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_1600_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_1600_move() {
    void (*end_1600_move_jp[6])() = { end_1600_0000, end_1600_1000, end_1600_2000,
                                      end_1600_3000, end_1600_3100, end_1600_5000 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 6)
        return;
    end_1600_move_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene 0 — horizontal pan with message. */
static void end_1600_0000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        Bg_On_W(1);
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        Rewrite_End_Message(1);
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal += 0x8000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos >= 480) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal = 0x1E00000;
        }

        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        break;

    case 2:
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 1 — fade to black panel. */
static void end_1600_1000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        /* fallthrough */

    case 1:
        if (Request_Fade(1)) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 1;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (end_fade_complete()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->free = 10;
            overwrite_panel(0xFF000000, 0x17);
        }

        break;

    case 3:
        overwrite_panel(0xFF000000, 0x17);
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free <= 0) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            g_state.end_w.timer = 0;
        }

        break;

    default:
        overwrite_panel(0xFF000000, 0x17);
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 2 — black panel fade-in with vertical scroll. */
static void end_1600_2000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        overwrite_panel(0xFF000000, 0x17);
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        /* fallthrough */

    case 1:
        overwrite_panel(0xFF000000, 0x17);

        if (Request_Fade(0)) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 1;
            Rewrite_End_Message(2);
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (end_fade_complete()) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            end_no_cut = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 3:
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal += 0x10000;

        if (bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos >= 384) {
            bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
            bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal = 0x1800000;
        }

        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 3 — effect with color cycling animation. */
static void end_1600_3000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        effect_E6_init(0x56);
        Rewrite_End_Message(3);
        bgw_ptr->l_limit2 = 2;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
        g_state.char_rewrite = 1;
        break;

    case 1:
        end_16_col_change();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 3 variant — effect with alternate color cycling. */
static void end_1600_3100() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        effect_E6_init(0x57);
        Rewrite_End_Message(4);
        g_state.char_rewrite = 2;
        break;

    case 1:
        end_16_col_change();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Scene 5 — final scene with flashing effect and fade timer. */
static void end_1600_5000() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        g_state.char_rewrite = 0;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_16_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        effect_E6_init(0x58);
        Rewrite_End_Message(5);
        bgw_ptr->free = 2;
        bgw_ptr->rewrite_flag = 0;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit2 = 2;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit = 0;
        end_fade_flag = 1;
        end_fade_timer = timer_16_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2] - 120;
        break;

    case 1:
        bgw_ptr->free--;

        if (bgw_ptr->free < 0) {
            bgw_ptr->free = 2;
            bgw_ptr->rewrite_flag ^= 1;

            if (bgw_ptr->rewrite_flag) {
                bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = 768;
                break;
            }

            bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = 256;
        }

        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Cycle palette colors for Chun-Li's ending. */
static void end_16_col_change() {
    bgw_ptr->l_limit2--;

    if (bgw_ptr->l_limit2 <= 0) {
        bgw_ptr->l_limit2 = 1;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit++;
        bgw_ptr->l_limit &= 1;
        g_state.c_number = bgw_ptr->l_limit;
    }
}

/**

 * Makoto's Ending
 */

#include "common.h"
#include "game_state.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_e6_ending_scene_gill_general.h"
#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_f9_text_message.h"

static void end_1100_move();
static void end_1101_move();
static void end_1102_move();

static void end_1100_common();
static void end_1100_3();
static void end_1100_6();

static void end_1101_2();
static void end_1101_3();

const s16 timer_11_tbl[7] = { 660, 480, 120, 180, 480, 1260, 420 };

const s16 end_11_pos[7][2] = { { 256, 768 }, { 768, 768 }, { 768, 768 }, { 256, 768 },
                               { 768, 512 }, { 256, 256 }, { 768, 256 } };

const s16 end_11_115_pos[4][3] = { { 768, 256, 1 }, { 256, 0, 2 }, { 768, 0, 2 }, { 768, 256, 1 } };

/** @brief Makoto's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_17000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x31);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_11_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 7) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_11_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[2].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_1100_move();
        end_1101_move();
        end_1102_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */
static void end_1100_move() {
    void (*end_1100_move_jp[7])() = { end_1100_common, end_1100_common, end_1100_common, end_1100_3,
                                      end_1100_common, end_1100_common, end_1100_6 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 7)
        return;
    end_1100_move_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Common scene handler — per-scene background setup with effects. */
static void end_1100_common() {
    switch (bgw_ptr->r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        bgw_ptr->r_no_1++;
        bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos = end_11_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][0];
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos = end_11_pos[g_state.end_w.r_no_2][1];
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = 512;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = 0;

        switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_2) {
        case 0:
            Bg_On_W(1);
            effect_E6_init(0);
            effect_E6_init(1);
            Rewrite_End_Message(1);
            break;

        case 1:
            Bg_Off_W(1);
            Rewrite_End_Message(2);
            break;

        case 2:
            Bg_On_W(1);
            Rewrite_End_Message(3);
            effect_E6_init(0x81);
            effect_E6_init(0x82);
            break;

        case 4:
            Bg_On_W(1);
            Rewrite_End_Message(5);
            break;

        case 5:
            effect_E6_init(3);
            effect_E6_init(4);
            effect_E6_init(5);
            Rewrite_End_Message(6);
            break;
        }

                bgw_ptr->speed_x = -0x8000;
                break;
            }

            bgw_ptr->speed_x = 0x8000;
            break;

        case 3:
            bgw_ptr->speed_x = 0;
            bgw_ptr->speed_y = 0x4000;

        }

        break;

        bgw_ptr->xy[0].cal += bgw_ptr->speed_x;
        bgw_ptr->xy[1].cal += bgw_ptr->speed_y;
        bgw_ptr->abs_x = bgw_ptr->xy[0].disp.pos;
        bgw_ptr->abs_y = bgw_ptr->xy[1].disp.pos;

const s16 end_18_pos[11][2] = { { 768, 768 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 768 }, { 768, 768 },
                                { 256, 512 }, { 256, 768 }, { 256, 512 }, { 256, 256 }, { 768, 512 } };

/** @brief Q's ending entry point — initialize and run all ending scenes. */
void end_18000(s16 pl_num) {
    switch (g_state.end_w.r_no_1) {
    case 0:
        g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
        g_state.end_w.r_no_2 = 0;
        common_end_init00(pl_num);
        common_end_init01();
        BGM_Request(0x32);
        g_state.end_w.timer = timer_18_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
        break;

    case 1:
        g_state.end_w.timer--;

        if (g_state.end_w.timer < 0) {
            g_state.end_w.r_no_2++;

            if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 11) {
                g_state.end_w.r_no_1++;
                g_state.end_w.end_flag = 1;
                fadeout_to_staff_roll();
                end_scn_pos_set2();
                end_bg_pos_adjust2();
                end_fam_set2();
                break;
            }

            g_state.end_w.timer = timer_18_tbl[g_state.end_w.r_no_2];
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[0].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[1].r_no_1 = 0;
            g_state.bg_w.bgw[2].r_no_1 = 0;
        }

        end_1800_move();
        /* fallthrough */

    case 2:
        end_scn_pos_set2();
        end_bg_pos_adjust2();
        end_fam_set2();
        break;
    }
}

/** @brief Dispatch to the current scene handler for background layer 0. */

                                       end_1800_0001, end_1800_0005, end_1800_0006, end_1800_0001,
                                       end_1800_0008, end_1800_0009, end_1800_0010 };
    bgw_ptr = &g_state.bg_w.bgw[0];
    if (g_state.end_w.r_no_2 >= 11)
        return;
    end_1800_move_jp[g_state.end_w.r_no_2]();
}

/** @brief Scene handler — per-scene background setup with per-scene effects. */
